name: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228)
description: Log4j JNDI lookup remote code execution. On the CISA KEV list since publication.
rationale: Remote code execution via unchecked logger input. NIST SI-2 requires timely flaw remediation; SI-3 malicious code protection; SI-10 input validation; RA-5 vulnerability monitoring. PCI DSS 6.3.3 requires applying critical patches within one month of release. Listed in CISA KEV — US federal directive 22-02 requires remediation.
